description: Four visually selected, widely spaced source views per artifact. Source paths are relative to the historical Photogrammetry archive. Frame labels retain original sequence numbering.
presentation: Full frames are proportionally resized and arranged on a neutral canvas with labels. No color correction, cropping, or generative image editing was applied for these collages.
